newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Repsol finds new gas field in western Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Repsol finds new gas field in western Egypt.

text.p: Spanish oil company Repsol said on Wednesday it had found a new gas field in the Khalda area, in the Western Desert of Egypt.
The new well, called Falak West-1, is near the Shams field discovered earlier by the company. Initial tests showed a potential capacity of 19,000 barrels a day of oil and gas, a statement added.
This latest find is the sixth in just eight months.

The statement added that a consortium formed by Repsol, Shell and U.S.-based Apache Corp had successfully completed the first exploratory drills in the North East Abu Gharadig concession. The well, which has been called BW-1, is 3,571 metres deep. During tests over 800 barrels a day of 34 API gravity crude oil were extracted.
Repsol is said to have a net production in Egypt of over 30,000 barrels a day.
